notes: M255 is v2.8's HARD go/no-go barrier and it PASSED. Two deliverables: the measurement floor (buildbench + two measured host profiles + a hard headroom assert, n=3 baseline 666.29 s) and the barrier verdict (GO — L1 does not collapse). Three findings reshaped the release rather than merely satisfying it: L2 re-priced from ~200 s down to <=45 s and re-sequenced after L1; D-v28-7's 'inert outlier' premise refuted (hiring's behaviour DOES change under union-apply, so M257 must re-verify the hiring recruiter Playthrough); and the corpus was found arguing against the barrier's own build shape. The headroom model was validated rather than merely applied — predicted 5,400 MiB, reps peaked 5,446 / 5,579 / 5,398 MB (~3 %).
